<span class="kicker">Data Story &nbsp;·&nbsp; OECD DAC &nbsp;·&nbsp; Bilateral Aid Flows 2010&#8211;2025</span>

::: {.lead}
Every dollar of foreign aid tells two stories: who gives, and who receives.
This chart maps flows from the five largest donors each year to the countries
that depend on that generosity most. Drag the slider to watch Ukraine's rise
from minor recipient to the world's largest aid destination after 2022 —
and to see how that shift displaced traditional recipients across Africa and South Asia.
:::

```{=html}
<p class="sk-note">

<script>
(function(){

var YEARS = [2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025];

// All donors ODA data
var ALL_DONORS = {
  'USA':         [30.4,31.1,30.7,31.5,33.1,31.1,33.6,35.3,34.0,34.6,35.5,42.3,55.3,64.5,60.2,25.9],
  'Germany':     [12.7,14.1,13.1,14.1,16.6,17.8,24.7,24.7,25.0,23.8,28.4,32.2,35.0,36.4,35.2,29.1],
  'EU Instit.':  [12.0,12.5,13.0,14.0,14.5,13.5,14.0,15.0,16.0,16.5,17.0,18.0,18.5,19.0,18.0,17.0],
  'Japan':       [11.2,10.8,10.5,11.6, 9.2, 9.2,10.4,11.5, 9.2,15.5,16.3,17.6,17.5,19.7,16.8,15.0],
  'France':      [12.9,13.1,12.0,11.4,10.6, 9.2, 9.6,11.3,12.2,12.2,14.1,15.4,15.9,15.1,14.5,12.9],
  'UK':          [13.0,13.9,13.9,17.9,19.4,18.7,18.0,17.9,19.4,19.6,18.6,15.8,15.5,15.0,14.2,13.5],
  'Canada':      [ 5.1, 5.5, 5.4, 4.9, 4.2, 4.3, 3.9, 4.3, 4.6, 4.7, 4.9, 6.1, 6.4, 6.0, 5.8, 5.5],
  'Norway':      [ 4.4, 4.9, 4.8, 5.0, 5.1, 4.3, 4.4, 4.1, 4.3, 4.4, 4.7, 4.7, 5.0, 5.0, 4.8, 4.5],
  'Sweden':      [ 4.5, 4.6, 5.2, 5.8, 6.2, 7.1, 6.8, 5.6, 5.8, 5.4, 5.2, 5.9, 5.0, 4.9, 4.6, 4.3],
  'Netherlands': [ 5.4, 6.3, 5.5, 5.4, 5.6, 5.8, 4.9, 4.9, 5.6, 5.3, 5.3, 5.3, 5.9, 5.2, 4.8, 4.5],
  'Switzerland': [ 2.3, 3.0, 3.0, 3.2, 3.2, 3.5, 3.6, 3.1, 3.1, 3.1, 3.1, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 4.3, 4.0],
  'Italy':       [ 3.1, 3.0, 2.7, 3.4, 3.1, 3.8, 5.0, 5.1, 5.0, 4.9, 4.8, 6.0, 6.0, 5.0, 4.8, 4.5],
  'Australia':   [ 3.8, 4.3, 5.1, 4.7, 4.2, 3.8, 3.1, 3.0, 2.9, 2.9, 2.8, 2.9, 3.0, 3.1, 3.0, 2.9],
  'Denmark':     [ 2.9, 2.9, 2.7, 2.7, 3.0, 2.6, 2.4, 2.4, 2.5, 2.5, 2.8, 2.9, 3.0, 2.9, 2.7, 2.5],
  'Spain':       [ 5.9, 4.2, 2.0, 2.0, 1.9, 1.7, 1.6, 2.4, 2.9, 3.0, 3.0, 3.5, 3.6, 3.5, 3.3, 3.1],
  'Belgium':     [ 3.0, 2.8, 2.3, 2.3, 2.4, 1.9, 2.2, 2.2, 2.2, 2.2, 2.4, 2.5, 2.5, 2.4, 2.3, 2.1]
};

// Donor colors
var DONOR_COLORS = {
  'USA':'#60a5fa','Germany':'#4ade80','UK':'#f87171',
  'France':'#c084fc','Japan':'#fb923c','EU Instit.':'#a78bfa',
  'Canada':'#f472b6','Norway':'#fbbf24','Sweden':'#22d3ee',
  'Netherlands':'#facc15','Switzerland':'#86efac','Italy':'#fca5a5',
  'Australia':'#67e8f9','Denmark':'#d8b4fe','Spain':'#fdba74','Belgium':'#a5b4fc'
};

// Recipient share keys and list
var REC_KEYS = [2010,2015,2020,2023,2025];
// Cols: Ukraine|Ethiopia|Bangladesh|Nigeria|India|DRC|Pakistan|Other
var RECIPS = ['Ukraine','Ethiopia','Bangladesh','Nigeria','India','DRC','Pakistan','Other'];

var REC_SHARES = {
  'USA':        [[0,8,5,8,5,7,12,55],[0,9,5,8,4,7,10,57],[1,9,5,8,3,8,8,58],[18,6,3,5,2,5,5,56],[20,5,3,5,2,5,5,55]],
  'Germany':    [[0,7,4,3,12,4,3,67],[1,8,4,3,10,4,3,67],[2,8,5,3,8,4,3,67],[22,6,3,2,5,3,2,57],[25,6,3,2,5,3,2,54]],
  'UK':         [[0,10,9,7,10,5,9,50],[1,11,9,7,8,5,8,51],[2,11,9,8,5,6,8,51],[15,8,7,6,3,5,7,49],[18,8,7,6,3,5,7,46]],
  'France':     [[0,3,2,4,6,5,2,78],[0,3,2,5,5,5,2,78],[2,3,3,5,4,6,2,75],[10,3,2,4,3,5,2,71],[12,3,2,4,3,5,2,69]],
  'Japan':      [[0,2,7,2,10,2,5,72],[0,2,7,2,8,2,5,74],[1,3,7,2,7,2,4,74],[4,3,7,2,6,2,4,72],[5,3,7,2,6,2,4,71]],
  'EU Instit.': [[0,5,3,5,4,6,2,75],[0,5,3,5,3,6,2,76],[2,5,3,5,3,6,2,74],[15,4,2,4,2,5,2,66],[18,4,2,4,2,5,2,63]],
  'Canada':     [[0,5,6,4,8,4,7,66],[0,6,6,4,7,4,6,67],[1,6,6,5,6,4,6,66],[12,5,5,4,5,4,5,60],[14,5,5,4,4,4,5,59]],
  'Norway':     [[0,8,4,5,3,5,3,72],[0,8,4,5,3,5,3,72],[1,8,4,5,2,5,3,72],[10,7,3,5,2,5,3,65],[12,7,3,5,2,5,3,63]],
  'Sweden':     [[0,7,4,5,3,5,3,73],[0,7,4,5,3,5,3,73],[1,7,4,5,3,5,3,72],[8,6,3,5,2,5,3,68],[10,6,3,5,2,5,3,66]],
  'Italy':      [[0,3,2,5,5,6,2,77],[0,3,2,5,4,6,2,78],[1,3,2,5,3,6,2,78],[8,3,2,5,3,6,2,71],[10,3,2,4,3,6,2,70]],
  'Australia':  [[0,2,8,2,6,2,5,75],[0,2,8,2,5,2,5,76],[0,2,8,2,5,2,4,77],[3,2,8,2,5,2,4,74],[4,2,8,2,5,2,4,73]],
  'Spain':      [[0,4,2,6,4,5,2,77],[0,4,2,6,4,5,2,77],[1,4,2,6,3,5,2,77],[9,4,2,6,3,5,2,69],[10,4,2,5,3,5,2,69]],
  'DEFAULT':    [[0,5,4,5,5,5,4,72],[0,5,4,5,4,5,4,73],[1,5,4,5,4,5,4,72],[10,5,3,5,3,5,3,66],[12,5,3,5,3,5,3,64]]
};

var REC_COLORS = {
  'Ukraine':'#60a5fa','Ethiopia':'#4ade80','Bangladesh':'#fb923c',
  'Nigeria':'#f87171','India':'#facc15','DRC':'#c084fc',
  'Pakistan':'#22d3ee','Other recipients':'#334d6e'
};

// Interpolation helper
function interp(year, keys, rows) {
  if (year <= keys[0]) return rows[0].slice();
  if (year >= keys[keys.length-1]) return rows[keys.length-1].slice();
  for (var i=0; i<keys.length-1; i++) {
    if (year >= keys[i] && year <= keys[i+1]) {
      var t = (year-keys[i])/(keys[i+1]-keys[i]);
      return rows[i].map(function(v,j){ return v + t*(rows[i+1][j]-v); });
    }
  }
  return rows[0].slice();
}

function getFlows(year) {
  var yi = YEARS.indexOf(year);

  // Sort donors by ODA this year, take top 5
  var donorODAs = {};
  Object.keys(ALL_DONORS).forEach(function(n){
    donorODAs[n] = ALL_DONORS[n][yi];
  });
  var top5 = Object.keys(donorODAs)
    .sort(function(a,b){ return donorODAs[b]-donorODAs[a]; })
    .slice(0,5);

  // Compute raw flows to all recipients
  var recipTotals = {};
  RECIPS.filter(function(r){return r!=='Other';}).forEach(function(r){
    recipTotals[r] = 0;
  });

  var rawByDonor = {};
  top5.forEach(function(donor){
    var oda = donorODAs[donor];
    var sharesData = REC_SHARES[donor] || REC_SHARES['DEFAULT'];
    var shares = interp(year, REC_KEYS, sharesData);
    rawByDonor[donor] = {};
    RECIPS.forEach(function(r,i){
      var val = oda * shares[i] / 100;
      rawByDonor[donor][r] = val;
      if (r !== 'Other') {
        recipTotals[r] = (recipTotals[r]||0) + val;
      }
    });
  });

  // Find top 4 recipients by total flow
  var top4 = Object.keys(recipTotals)
    .sort(function(a,b){ return recipTotals[b]-recipTotals[a]; })
    .slice(0,4);

  // Build final flows collapsing non-top4 into 'Other recipients'
  var flows = [];
  top5.forEach(function(donor){
    var otherVal = 0;
    RECIPS.forEach(function(r){
      var val = rawByDonor[donor][r];
      if (top4.indexOf(r) >= 0) {
        if (val >= 0.05) flows.push({source:donor, target:r, value:val});
      } else {
        otherVal += val;
      }
    });
    if (otherVal >= 0.1) {
      flows.push({source:donor, target:'Other recipients', value:otherVal});
    }
  });

  return {flows:flows, top5:top5, top4:top4};
}

function drawSankey(year) {
  var result = getFlows(year);
  var flows = result.flows;

  var wrap = document.getElementById('sk-sankey');
  wrap.innerHTML = '';

  var ML=145, MR=160, MT=16, MB=16;
  var totalW = (wrap.parentElement.clientWidth||860) - 40;
  var W = totalW - ML - MR;
  var H = 380;

  var svg = d3.select('#sk-sankey').append('svg')
    .attr('width', totalW)
    .attr('height', H+MT+MB)
    .append('g')
    .attr('transform','translate('+ML+','+MT+')');

  // Build ordered node list: sources left, targets right
  var srcOrder = result.top5;
  var tgtSeen = [];
  flows.forEach(function(f){
    if(tgtSeen.indexOf(f.target)<0) tgtSeen.push(f.target);
  });
  // Put 'Other recipients' last
  tgtSeen = tgtSeen.filter(function(r){return r!=='Other recipients';});
  tgtSeen.push('Other recipients');

  var allNames = srcOrder.concat(tgtSeen);
  var nodes = allNames.map(function(n){return {name:n};});
  var links = flows.map(function(f){
    return {
      source: allNames.indexOf(f.source),
      target: allNames.indexOf(f.target),
      value: Math.max(f.value, 0.01)
    };
  });

  var sk = d3.sankey()
    .nodeWidth(16).nodePadding(12)
    .extent([[0,0],[W,H]]);

  var g = sk({
    nodes: nodes.map(function(d){return Object.assign({},d);}),
    links: links.map(function(d){return Object.assign({},d);})
  });

  function nColor(name){
    return DONOR_COLORS[name] || REC_COLORS[name] || '#475569';
  }

  // Links
  svg.append('g').selectAll('path').data(g.links).join('path')
    .attr('d', d3.sankeyLinkHorizontal())
    .attr('stroke', function(d){return nColor(d.source.name);})
    .attr('stroke-width', function(d){return Math.max(1,d.width);})
    .attr('fill','none').attr('opacity',0.32)
    .on('mouseover',function(){d3.select(this).attr('opacity',0.62);})
    .on('mouseout', function(){d3.select(this).attr('opacity',0.32);})
    .append('title')
    .text(function(d){
      return d.source.name+' \u2192 '+d.target.name+': $'+d.value.toFixed(1)+'B';
    });

  // Nodes
  svg.append('g').selectAll('rect').data(g.nodes).join('rect')
    .attr('x',function(d){return d.x0;})
    .attr('y',function(d){return d.y0;})
    .attr('height',function(d){return Math.max(2,d.y1-d.y0);})
    .attr('width',function(d){return d.x1-d.x0;})
    .attr('fill',function(d){return nColor(d.name);})
    .attr('rx',2)
    .append('title')
    .text(function(d){return d.name+': $'+d.value.toFixed(1)+'B';});

  // Labels
  svg.append('g').selectAll('text').data(g.nodes).join('text')
    .attr('x',function(d){return d.x0<W/2 ? d.x0-8 : d.x1+8;})
    .attr('y',function(d){return (d.y0+d.y1)/2;})
    .attr('dy','0.35em')
    .attr('text-anchor',function(d){return d.x0<W/2?'end':'start';})
    .attr('fill','#94a3b8')
    .attr('font-size',11)
    .attr('font-family',"'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif")
    .text(function(d){return d.name;});

  // Update legend
  var legend = document.getElementById('sk-legend');
  if (legend) {
    legend.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#64748b;font-size:11px;margin-right:6px">Top 5 donors:</span>';
    result.top5.forEach(function(name){
      var item = document.createElement('span');
      item.className = 'sk-legend-item';
      item.innerHTML = '<span class="sk-legend-dot" style="background:'+nColor(name)+'"></span>'+name;
      legend.appendChild(item);
    });
  }
}

function update(year) {
  document.getElementById('sk-yr').textContent = year;
  document.getElementById('sk-prelim').style.display = year>=2024?'inline':'none';
  drawSankey(year);
}

document.getElementById('sk-slider').addEventListener('input', function(){
  update(parseInt(this.value));
});

var _rt;
window.addEventListener('resize', function(){
  clearTimeout(_rt);
  _rt = setTimeout(function(){
    update(parseInt(document.getElementById('sk-slider').value));
  }, 200);
});

if (document.readyState==='loading') {
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){ update(2023); });
} else {
  update(2023);
}

})();
</script>
```

---

**Sources:** OECD DAC Statistics. Final 2024 data released December 2025;
preliminary 2025 data released April 2026.
Recipient country shares are illustrative estimates based on OECD DAC
bilateral ODA tables and CRS project-level data.
